messages:
deploy-bot: roll out started: rollout-id=rl-2026-03-17-09:45 canary slice 5 -> 10% traffic
incident-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_breach @canary-slice-5 p95 increased from 120ms to 1.2s across gen endpoints (automated page)
maria (oncall): seeing it, joining now. tagging eng-runtime @alex and SRE ops @sre-ops
alex (runtime): pulling metrics — looks like kernel selection flipped to fallback kernels on the canary hosts after the new kernel picker landed in rl-2026-03-17. KV cache hit rate unchanged, but batch queue depth is high and throughput dropped.
sre-ops: logs show a spike of kernel fallback reasons: OOM_TEMP and UNOPT_SUPPORTED for quantized ops
maria (oncall): customer impact? any 5xxs?
customer-success-bot: 3 customers reported 5xxs for /v1/generate over last 4m: acct-349 (critical), acct-522 (low), acct-88 (trial). CS reached out to acct-349 and opened incident C-2026-0317-1
zane (eng): is this the prefetch/kv change from the rollout?
alex (runtime): yes, the rollout enabled kernel-reroute heuristics + prefetch window adjustment. Looks like on some GPUs that chooses a slow fallback path when sequence len > 512. Canary traffic has a heavier tail so it triggered.
maria (oncall): mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to disable kernel-reroute for canary, 2) kill-rollout (rollback), 3) pin canary to older runtime image, 4) temporary traffic-cut to canary. Preferences?
ken: recommend flag flip first to minimize blast radius. If that doesn't normalize p95 in 2m, rollback.
alex (runtime): I can flip the flag. Flag key: `ff.kernel_reroute_enabled` -> set false for canary slice.
maria (oncall): do it and post command/output
alex (runtime): running:
```
redwoodctl feature-flag set ff.kernel_reroute_enabled=false --scope=canary-slice-5
OK: updated scope canary-slice-5
```
incident-bot: ACTION: feature flag change applied by alex. Observability: collecting 2m window
sre-ops: p95 trending down from 1.2s -> 430ms after ~45s. still above baseline but improving.
maria (oncall): good. hold for 3m to confirm. CS keep impacted customers posted.
customer-success-bot: acct-349 replied: their app experienced timeouts but is recovering. Asked for ETA on fix. Shared workaround: decrease request size.
zane (eng): any kernel fallback logs post-flag?
alex (runtime): fallback events dropped ~90% after flag flip. remaining p95 due to batch queue backlog. I suggest reducing max_batch_size on canary from 64 -> 32 to drain queues faster.
maria (oncall): can we apply that at routing layer quickly?
alex (runtime): yes. pushing route config update:
```
redwoodctl route update canary-slice-5 --max-batch=32 --drain=true
OK: route updated
```
sre-ops: metrics: throughput recovered to ~85% of baseline, p95 ~200ms now. error rate back to normal.
maria (oncall): amazing. what's next? do we keep rollout paused?\enote: planned decision message
ken: keep rollout paused. we need a proper rollback + root cause. handoff to morning sweep to run full canary replay and run longer-tail traffic. alex and zane to own postmortem.
zane (eng): let's capture timeline and diffs. I will snapshot the canary config and runtime logs to the incident channel and start a git revert PR for the kernel picker change.
maria (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-2026-0317-14, severity=S1 (customer-impacting). Adding owners: alex, zane, ken. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0317-14
customer-success-bot: notified acct-349 with mitigation steps and ETA 3h for full fix.
alex (runtime): quick root-cause note: heuristic for kernel selection used a latency probe that mis-classified certain quantized-attention patterns as unsupported on preferred kernels, falling back to a very slow generic kernel. Edge case surfaced by canary's seq-length distribution.
maria (oncall): excellent. action items in ticket: 1) revert kernel picker PR (zane) 2) add probe for seq_len tail to canary test (alex) 3) postmortem + customer communication (ken) 4) add runbook step for immediate flag flip (maria)
ken: I'll take postmortem comms and coordinate with CS. If anything regresses while I'm oncall, wake me up. :phone: 
maria (oncall): handoff to day: @ken is day-oncall. I'm marking this thread resolved for night shift; will update if anything changes. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
